arguments.query:
SELECT time, process_name AS child_process_name, pid AS child_pid, ppid AS parent_pid, command_line AS child_command_line, parent_process_name, parent_process_path, parent_command_line, event_record_id, source_stream
FROM audit_logs
WHERE parent_process_name LIKE '%winword.exe%'
  AND time >= (
    SELECT MIN(time) FROM audit_logs WHERE process_name LIKE '%winword.exe%'
  )
  AND time < datetime((
    SELECT MIN(time) FROM audit_logs WHERE process_name LIKE '%winword.exe%'
  ), '+5 minutes')
  AND (
    childproc_name IS NOT NULL
    OR event_id IN (1, 4688)
    OR process_name IS NOT NULL
  )
  AND (process_name IS NOT NULL OR childproc_name IS NOT NULL)
ORDER BY time ASC, event_record_id ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT time, process_name AS child_process_name, pid AS child_pid, ppid AS parent_pid, command_line AS child_command_line, parent_process_name, parent_process_path, parent_command_line, event_record_id, source_stream
FROM audit_logs
WHERE parent_process_name LIKE '%winword.exe%'
  AND time >= (
    SELECT MIN(time) FROM audit_logs WHERE process_name LIKE '%winword.exe%'
  )
  AND time < datetime((
    SELECT MIN(time) FROM audit_logs WHERE process_name LIKE '%winword.exe%'
  ), '+5 minutes')
  AND (
    childproc_name IS NOT NULL
    OR event_id IN (1, 4688)
    OR process_name IS NOT NULL
  )
  AND (process_name IS NOT NULL OR childproc_name IS NOT NULL)
ORDER BY time ASC, event_record_id ASC
LIMIT 1;

arguments.query:
WITH seed AS (
  SELECT time, pid, ppid, process_name, command_line, parent_process_name, parent_process_path, parent_command_line, object, access, access_mask, access_list, raw_event_type, event_id
  FROM audit_logs
  WHERE process_name LIKE '%winword.exe%'
     OR parent_process_name LIKE '%winword.exe%'
     OR parent_command_line LIKE '%winword.exe%'
     OR command_line LIKE '%winword.exe%'
), first_time AS (
  SELECT MIN(time) AS t0 FROM seed
), candidates AS (
  SELECT s.*
  FROM seed s
  JOIN first_time f ON s.time BETWEEN f.t0 AND datetime(f.t0, '+5 minutes')
  WHERE (
    lower(COALESCE(s.access,'')) LIKE '%write%'
    OR lower(COALESCE(s.access,'')) LIKE '%create%'
    OR lower(COALESCE(s.access_mask,'')) LIKE '%write%'
    OR lower(COALESCE(s.access_list,'')) LIKE '%write%'
    OR lower(COALESCE(s.raw_event_type,'')) LIKE '%file%' 
    OR lower(COALESCE(s.raw_event_type,'')) LIKE '%create%'
    OR lower(COALESCE(s.raw_event_type,'')) LIKE '%write%'
    OR lower(COALESCE(s.object,'')) LIKE '%.exe%'
    OR lower(COALESCE(s.object,'')) LIKE '%.doc%'
    OR lower(COALESCE(s.object,'')) LIKE '%.dll%'
  )
)
SELECT time, pid, ppid, process_name, command_line, parent_process_name, parent_process_path, parent_command_line, object, access, access_mask, access_list, raw_event_type
FROM candidates
ORDER BY time ASC
LIMIT 1;
